categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and services of large and medium-sized military aircraft, civil aviation components, and aviation services. Key products include military transport aircraft, bombers, special aircraft, and major components for domestic and international civil aircraft such as C909, C919, AG600, Boeing 737, and Airbus A320 series. It also provides aviation engineering technical support, user training, material support, and aircraft maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital design and manufacturing technologies, focusing on integrated manufacturing of aircraft fuselage and wings. It has developed a digitalized aircraft development system and holds numerous national patents. The production methods emphasize lean management, intelligent manufacturing, and collaborative innovation across design, manufacturing, and supply chain to ensure high-quality and timely delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military and civil aviation sectors, international aircraft manufacturers such as Airbus and Boeing, and Chinese commercial aircraft companies like COMAC. The company serves both domestic and international markets, providing components and services for military and civil aircraft, including emergency rescue and low-altitude economy applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant production bases in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and other locations in Northwest and North China. It also participates in international cooperation projects and exports components globally, maintaining long-term partnerships with major international aircraft manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace supply chain, focusing on aircraft assembly, component manufacturing, and after-sales services. It acts as a major integrator and supplier of key aircraft structural components and aviation services within the aerospace industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening military-civil integration, advancing innovation-driven development, and enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company focuses on breakthroughs in key technologies for large and medium-sized aircraft, expanding civil aviation subcontracting, and developing aviation services. It also emphasizes supply chain optimization, cost reduction, and sustainable development aligned with national aerospace strategies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aircraft and aviation components, subcontracting manufacturing services for international and domestic aircraft programs, and providing aviation maintenance and technical support services. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and leasing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading aerospace manufacturer in China, holding a significant position in both military and civil aviation sectors. It competes with other major Chinese aerospace firms and international suppliers by leveraging its integrated manufacturing capabilities and strategic partnerships with global aircraft manufacturers. It is recognized for high-quality production and innovation in the aerospace supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 43.22 billion RMB, representing a 7.23% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 1.02 billion RMB, up 18.87%. Total assets stood at around 73.81 billion RMB with a net asset value of 21.02 billion RMB. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and operational efficiency over recent years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, efficient, low-cost, and sustainable aerospace manufacturing. It differentiates itself through advanced digitalized design and manufacturing systems, comprehensive military and civil aviation product lines, and integrated aviation services. Its strong innovation capabilities, strategic international partnerships, and commitment to customer satisfaction underpin its competitive advantage.
